summary: Steep, narrow dead-end lane with houses hard against the kerb and no room to pull off.

best_section.where: Bottom of the lane near the bend, west side

drivers.seclusion: Houses within 9 m on the west side and more 22-27 m beyond; trees close in.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with trees and fences either side; no clear ground to pull out of the lane.
drivers.convention: No sign of parked vehicles along this section.

flags: Dwelling 9 m from kerb at 25 m
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy on both sides.
